grn.text: When Niv-Mizzet disappeared into secret research, Ral Zarek found himself leading the Izzet as acting guildleader, the first time he had harnessed the power of an entire guild.
Niv-Mizzet had him head Project Lightning Bug to track Jace, and Ral built the tracking enchantment, then helped Jace fabricate evidence that it was unreliable so Niv-Mizzet lost interest.
His storm also detected planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica, and Ral learned of four of them, warning Jace at a Rakdos Carnarium.

Later he joined the effort around the maze and Guildpact, absorbing the weird Melek into his gauntlet and declaring himself Izzet maze runner, until Jace united the champions' minds and became Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.

war.text: Bolas had recruited the young Ral Zarek on Ravnica, and Niv-Mizzet revealed he knew Ral was a planeswalker and that Bolas planned to invade, promising Ral control of the Izzet.

Ral staged a Golgari attack on Orzhova so Kaya could kill the Obzedat, but Dovin Baan sabotaged his great machine, and Ral activated the Interplanar Beacon after defeating Vraska at the cost of Hekara's life.

When Bolas brought the Immortal Sun to Ravnica and trapped the planeswalkers, Ral drained the Beacon to blast off God-Eternal Kefnet's arm, then led the plan to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

After the war Niv-Mizzet gave up the guildmastership to Ral, who survived a no-confidence vote, married Tomik, and was assigned to hunt Tezzeret, who beat him in combat and gave him his damaged arm as proof of the kill.

mh1.text: Ral Zarek appears on this set's cards as a planeswalker who talks about good ideas.

otj.text: On Thunder Junction, Ral Zarek built an interplanar relay tower at Omenport and hired the Sterling Company to protect his work creating communication lines across the Omenpaths.

He took Kellan onto his security detail, and on the road they met Oko, whose illusion collapsed when he sensed Kellan's fae magic; later Ral was stunned to see Vraska alive among Oko's gang before Rakdos knocked him aside.
Ral led the Sterling army against Tarnation, then freed Kellan from a prison wagon and proposed taking back the vault's key and locking its treasure away on another plane, and Kellan joined him.

In the vault, Ashiok, who was Jace Beleren in disguise, incapacitated Ral, Kellan and Annie, and Jace vanished with Vraska and a child, after which Ral later offered Kellan a job on Ravnica, which he declined.

blb.text: Back on Ravnica, Ral Zarek vowed to kill Jace for hiding as Ashiok, and after the Wanderer told him her spark was gone, he returned to the ruins of Tarnation and followed Jace's aether trail into the Blind Eternities.
He arrived in Bloomburrow transformed into an otterfolk and met Mabel's party, grabbing Helga after seeing her drawing, since she was his only link to Jace, and pledging to keep them all alive.
When a lightning-wreathed dragon-hawk attacked, Ral recognized it as a dragon from another plane and, with Finneas's copper-wire arrow as a lightning rod, channeled a storm into it.
After Helga spoke a prophecy at Fountainport and Mabel gave him buttons for his husband, Ral vanished in an explosion of lightning sparks.
